title: Comunicado 2025-12-16
summary: The Consejo unanimously cut the policy rate 25bp to 4.5%, resuming the normalisation it had paused in October. The statement is built on a markedly better inflation picture: headline and core both fell to 3.4% in November, inflation declined faster than projected in the September IPoM, two-year expectations sit at 3%, and the December IPoM central scenario now has inflation reaching the 3% target in Q1 2026, with risks to convergence described as reduced. Versus the October communique, which held and explicitly said it was warranted to 'accumulate more information' before continuing to bring the rate toward neutral, that conditional brake is dropped, but no new forward guidance replaces it: the Consejo will simply evaluate next moves according to the macro scenario. A somewhat stronger external impulse, copper above US$5, investment surprising up and still-elevated global risks keep the text balanced, so it reads as a cut with neutral, data-dependent guidance near the neutral range rather than a signal of continued easing.

key_quotes.quote: En su Reunión de Política Monetaria, el Consejo del Banco Central de Chile acordó reducir la tasa de interés de política monetaria en 25 puntos base, hasta 4,5%.
key_quotes.context: Unanimous 25bp cut after the October pause

key_quotes.quote: La inflación se ha reducido más rápido que lo proyectado en septiembre, en un entorno económico local y global algo mejor que lo esperado.
En el escenario central del IPoM de diciembre, la inflación llegaría a la meta de 3% en el primer trimestre de 2026.
key_quotes.context: Target convergence pulled forward; risks to convergence reduced

key_quotes.quote: El Consejo evaluará los próximos movimientos de la TPM considerando la evolución del escenario macroeconómico y sus implicancias para la convergencia inflacionaria.
key_quotes.context: October's 'accumulate more information' brake dropped; no explicit path for further cuts
